groups.activity: research Fieldron (if missing), then Kreska, then Ocucor

rows.label: Fieldron research
rows.note: 5,000 cr + 5 Fieldron Sample + 100 Rubedo + 500 Nano Spores + 200 Polymer Bundle, 72h; skip if the lab already has it
rows.alt: buy the reusable BP for 15,000 cr

rows.label: Kreska research
rows.note: 10,000 cr + 25 Fieldron Sample + 5 Thermal Sludge + 10 Axidrol Alloy + 1 Recaster Neural Relay, 3 days; only needs to be researched, not built

rows.label: Ocucor research
rows.note: 10,000 cr + 25 Fieldron Sample + 5 Gorgaricus Spore + 10 Travocyte Alloy + 1 Eye-Eye Rotoblade, 3 days

rows.label: Ocucor Blueprint
rows.alt: join a clan that already researched it

conditions: Kreska is a hard prerequisite for Ocucor but only needs to be researched, never built.
One research project runs at a time per lab; queue Kreska before you go fishing so the clock isn't idle.
Costs shown are Ghost-clan; multiply x3/x10/x30/x100 for Shadow/Storm/Mountain/Moon.
bonuses: A member of an established clan can walk in and buy the blueprint the same day, skipping six days of research and the Kreska prereq entirely.

groups.activity: queue 10 Fieldron, one at a time
groups.meta: 15,000 cr + 10 Fieldron Sample + 1 Control Module + 500 Salvage + 250 Plastids each, 12h; foundry holds only one

rows.label: Fieldron
rows.note: five real days end to end since only one builds at a time

conditions: Start this the same day as the Kreska research so the week isn't wasted waiting on one when the other could've run in parallel.

disclosures.title: the real bottleneck
disclosures.body: Ten Fieldron, one at a time, is the single biggest time sink in the whole Ocucor farm — bigger than any material gathering.

groups.activity: mine, fish and loot for the build materials
groups.meta: Outworlder rank needed for the Venerdo Alloy blueprint

rows.label: Venerol
rows.note: refines into 55+ Venerdo Alloy across three builds

rows.label: Thermal Sludge
rows.note: Corpus encampment containers; also a common Vallis bounty reward

rows.label: Charamote Sagan Module
rows.note: one per Charamote caught in a cave hotspot with Shockprod or Stunna spear; any grade works

rows.label: Gorgaricus Spore
rows.note: purple sacs under the giant Vallis mushrooms

rows.label: Travocyte Alloy
rows.note: one refine (yields 20) from Travoride, Neutral-rank blueprint

conditions: Venerdo Alloy is refined, not mined directly: build the blueprint from Smokefinger at Outworlder rank, 1,000 cr + 20 Venerol + 300 Rubedo + 2 Gallium per batch of 20.
Don't chase perfect catches — fish quality changes only Scrap and standing, the Sagan Module is 1 per Charamote at any grade.
Stop feeding Helminth mid-farm: Thermal Sludge is Bile and Gorgaricus Spore is Biotics, an easy way to eat your own build costs.
bonuses: Bring Charamote Bait and hit a cave pool instead of fishing the surface.

rows.label: Ocucor
rows.note: 25,000 cr + 10 Fieldron + 40 Thermal Sludge + 55 Venerdo Alloy + 20 Charamote Sagan Module

rows.label: Sentient Surge
rows.note: Ocucor augment; refills 20% magazine per kill, +60% crit/status per active tendril
rows.alt: Naberus shop at Daughter, 50 Mother Tokens

conditions: Any reload deletes every tendril, including a cancelled reload or holster; host migration also resets the crit/status stacks.
The bonus is additive with other crit/status mods, not multiplicative — build for base damage.
bonuses: Reload-avoidance mods (Eject Magazine, Synth set, Cyte-09's Resupply) refill ammo without wiping tendrils.
Wants a buffer/CC frame: Saryn, Volt, Mirage, Rhino, Nova, or Yareli for the auto-aim on Merulina.

disclosures.title: the augment is the actual farm
disclosures.body: The weapon itself is a formality; before Sentient Surge moved to the permanent Cred store it was the real cost (200-300p in 2024). The gun is 'ok and serviceable' without it and a top-tier room clearer with it.
